record.title: Decode retained Android debug-bridge frames under an explicit checksum profile
record.intent: Separate raw transport framing from claims about instrument actions.
requirements: Pin the Android reference protocol and implementation provenance and document their checksum terminology difference before implementing a pure offline frame decoder.

Model the six supported cleartext commands as typed alternatives with exact private wire bytes and bounded header payload frame-count and total extents; reject unsupported or incomplete framing explicitly.
Require the additive payload checksum under the first profile; do not silently accept omitted checksums or infer compatibility with other protocol versions.
Preserve accepted prefixes and structural rejection information without creating connections launching adb or contacting any device.
acceptance: Independent synthetic framing controls establish the documented checksum-required decoder boundary.
